Return the current value of every tracked metric for one entity (the whole network, an Ecosystem, a Credential Schema, or a Participant sub-tree) at the block selected by the At-Block-Height header, or the latest indexed block when omitted. Participant counts read from the entity_participant_changes log; the other metrics read from the height-versioned entity tables. Replaces GET /v4/metrics/all.
